title: Deadlock Zipline Boost
description:
An always-visible Ready / Active / Cooldown timer for the zipline speed boost.

- Icon with title and state, bottom centre-left above the HUD; hidden in the hideout
- Sits next to [CompLock HUD++](https://deadlockconfig.com/) without overriding hud.xml
- A "Zipline Boost" tab in HUD++, or an ADDONS window in the Esc menu without HUD++; one toggle, on by default
- MIT. The overlay look is adapted from the Zip Boost overlay in [QOLLOCK](https://github.com/civo7/QOLLOCK) by civo7 (Apache-2.0)
author: luxus
